I settled on Platinum Solar Designs for my solar installation for a variety of reasons and was not disappointed at any point throughout the process.I have a small-ish house with the roof facing multiple directions, which was always going to be problematic with fitting a suitable system. Platinum Solar provided a solution that maximised my North and West roof spaces, using 440w panels and adding in a user-programable timer on the hot water line to maximise my peak daylight times. I settled on a 4.4kW system, which will adequately meet our fairly spartan electricity needs and was comfortable with a hot water timer over other more expensive options.Once I accepted the quote, the admin team kept me constantly updated as things progressed and were always responsive to answer my many questions.On the installation day - the team were on time for the start and explained how the installation day would go. I found all team members very friendly, polite and I was given a full explanation once the system become active on what was done and how it all worked - including a run down on how the monitoring app works.Platinum Solar organised all components of the grid connection and the only thing I will need to organise is locking in my feed plan once my meter becomes ‘active’ on the grid (this was explained to me how this would work).Overall - I am extremely happy with a very stress free installation, where everything was explained, all options were discussed and no issues were encountered.Would definitely recommend Platinum Solar to anyone else
